description: This file defines an enumeration 'LegalForm' used to represent and differentiate between client legal forms such as 'Person' and 'Entity' within the Fineract system. It includes properties, constructors, and utility methods related to these kinds.

classes.name: LegalForm
classes.description: An enum representing the legal form of a client, with types 'Person' and 'Entity', along with associated properties and utility methods.
